change_summary: Hoisted w_n_base = W_ptr + offs_n * s_wn and valid_wn = offs_n < OUT_C outside the K-loop (loop-invariant), and replaced the full 2D w_ptrs recomputation inside the loop with w_k_off = in_c*s_wc + kh*s_wh + kw*s_ww (1D, K-varying only) broadcast-added to w_n_base[None,:] + w_k_off[:,None], eliminating the large-stride offs_n*s_wn multiply from the hot path.
